EN: A Priest! I have an important question for you.
Even your Human presence cannot disturb my divine equanimity. What do you wish to know?
Some of my friends plan to build a tower high enough to reach our God, then to sever the chains that hold us in poverty. Is this a wise idea?
This story sounds familiar - If only I knew where I have heard it before...
Do you think such an undertaking is doomed to failure?
It is bound to fail simply because your Human God clearly does not exist!
So you may think Elven Lord, and yet I still fear the fury of God.
My time is too precious to waste on such nonsense.
I have found the poachers. Now that I have their heads, I can deliver them to Brombar.
This drought gets worse with every passing day! I ask myself why the heavens frown on us!
I wish I knew the answer to that! Our fields are like dust bowls. All the green leaves have withered and died.
It was different in the old days. The land was fertile back then.
That's what they say. They also say that the land of milk and honey lies on the other side of the Elven Wall.
Yes, but I've never heard of anyone ever returning from the other side.
Neither have I. We just have to withstand it, and try to persevere.
Yes, this is our fate. We'll have to continue our fight for survival - day in and day out.
Oh, but it can be such a soul-destroying struggle some days.
You're here? I just saw you in the underworld!
You look like a real Elf's ugly cousin!
An Elf is still an Elf, no matter what she calls herself!
They say you fell from a tree?
You look like a Forest Elf to me...
Dryads, High Elves, whatever! Death awaits you!
The boy wants another bucket of water. I feel like a water carrier!

When I found out how my grandfather does business, I wanted to go to the commandant's office right away to tell them everything. My uncle wouldn't let me, he threatened terrible things if I betrayed the family. Finally he dragged me here.
Please take me to the next village.
Just as I expected,  the novice’s father was not particularly pleased to receive the letter.
Connection to PlayStation®Network established. The current game will be closed.
Connection to Xbox LIVE established. The current game will be closed.
When I watch over the sleeping, dreams come true...
When dawn draws near, my bed begins to call out to me.
This job is a piece of cake on clear and starry nights.
Sometimes the dark night can be so frightening.
I like being outside at night.
I protect law and order for the citizens of the town.
The meadows are shrouded in a mysterious fog.
A thick coat keeps me warm at night.
Night is for work and day is for rest.
Now that I have finished my work I can take a look around the gardens.
What's concerns me even more is that the young are prone to blasphemous utterances that will anger Kybele, you know what I mean?
Kybele called to me recently, she believes that many of our children blaspheme her for no reason! What do you think about that?
What are we to do with those who constantly blaspheme our wonderful, praise worthy Goddess? I think they should be horribly punished for their blasphemies!
A terribly bad habit is taking hold here! The great Goddess has seldom been laughed at as often as she is nowadays, do you see it too?
How do we deal with the bawdy people among our children, who insist on performing mischievous deeds in the name of the Goddess?
The Goddess seems to be angry with us! She informed me in a vision that some of the people deny her name and ridicule her!
Disbelief seems to be noticeably increasing among our children! Maybe we should impose the death penalty on blasphemy, what do you think?
I'm reluctantly merciful with those who continue to renounce the Goddess' name! What do you think of crucifixions?
I have a hard time accepting that some of the children still misuse the Goddess' name. What about you?
The Goddess' name must never be dragged through the mud! Never! Doubters should be put to death.
The Inquisition turns against the Maker!
You can't even be used as fertiliser!
I’m sure he can shed some light on the truth.
I am supposed to accompany Dr. Faust to Mephisto.

You there! What did you talk to Mechthild about? Did you tell her about the gold? I'm sure that is the reason why she wants to call off the wedding. How does that make me look? Like I'm the village idiot's assistant!
I demand statusf... shatisfa... I want revenge! And when I'm done with you I'm going to give Mechthild a good beating!
Then I will restore our honor.
Be careful! I need living specimens.

It says on the treasure map: Propperti of highwai banditt Winnhard.

The treasure map seems to point to a nearby pond . It says “pondd” right here. I could have a look, but I'm not expecting much from a bandit who couldn't even spell his own name.
This item cannot be used yet.
The farmer's wife must have already suspected something. She is very calm about her husband's death.
Who are you? Take your fingers off me, I'm coming with you.
Now tell me: How do you like being dead?
Now we have to go and visit the location where he was cursed and take the prince along.
It goes for this village too, woe betide those who harbor heretic ideas!

Ask the commander of the northern camp about the outlaws!

Pardon me, but did I just see Shirka Alana? The leader of that group of outlaws that everyone is looking for? I'm sure it was her! The commander of the northern camp has dealt with this group on more than one occasion. If you want to know anything about them, ask him.
I am content when the houses of enemies are burning.
Militant? Of course we are militant!
During the last battle, I had to safeguard the supply line.
In the last skirmish, I didn't eat or drink for two days.
I am going to fight to defend my people.
I have good vision. I can see just as well at night as I can during the day.
Either we are victorious, or we pay with our lives.
Sadly, a few good comrades were killed in the last battle.

Find my daughter and rescue her!

I need your help, my friend. I don’t know who else I can turn to. I‘ve made a mess of things. I know that soldiers aren’t allowed to gamble, but I was a having a run of good luck at dice, so I bet all of my wages.

Then all of a sudden, lady luck deserted me. I had to borrow money, and I couldn’t pay it back. So that old crook of a usurer, Damial, took my daughter Claressa as collateral. Now I have the money, but my daughter is gone. I’m afraid that Damial has sold her into slavery.

Help an old friend and save my daughter! If I take care of this matter myself, my superiors will find out that I was gambling, and I will be dishonorably discharged.
Thank you for escorting us, we're safe now. This is for your services, be seeing you!
You can run, but you cannot hide!
More opponents, I have a five-year-plan to fulfill!

The Master is dead
I failed to keep his skin safe!
The world is so cruel!
I'll read you the riot act.
The beast did indeed exist and it was not easy to defeat. It was a great fight!
Actually, we could be partners... But I don't like to share!

There's something about the outside of a horse that's good for the inside of a man! That's nonsense, I tell you! Riding only makes your backside hurt. Selling it is the best thing a man can do with a horse.
Well, everybody! That's ... that's really touching.
Dear Gods! What have I done to deserve ... I mean ... Good to see you!
I certainly did not expect to see you here. But, well, the more sword arms there are on my side the better.
Well, okay. The more swords the better.
Maybe I should start collecting toad heads, too ...

You've brought the excavation supervisor! I feared the worst when I heard about the ambush. Thank you for saving the excavation site. Let me give you this ancient object as a reward. It belonged to an ancestor of Fahid ben Sahid. It will bring you luck.

Mark Intelman
Why am I the only normal human being on this planet?!
Sports Can Be Hazardous to Your Health
It seems like the Djinn wants to take out his newfound freedom on me. I should teach him some manners.
I've collected all five herbs. They smell really good. I should take them to the Priestess now.
I would rather accompany you, but if you insist...
They are Koremar and Lienna's children! Don't worry, I'll take them safely back to their parents. Thank you very much!
This world will not miss you.
Ker won't protect you from me.
Cowardice seems to be part of your strategy, Inquisitor.
Without the cogwheel, no diving bell.
Tree-Elves are just as bad as the others!
First of all, you should dress yourself decently, Dryad!
We like to see Dryads around here - dead ones, that is.
Hey, mummy, where are your burial objects?
Your face looks quite pale, zombie ...
You should have stayed in your hole ...
Now I'll ice you ... since you're already cold ...
In the past you might have been my kind of guy, but lately you let yourself go ...
Slave Trader Innohep has asked me to pick up a new shipment of gladiators. He will pay me well for this task.
She's like the blossom of a desert flower, beautiful with a pleasant smell.

What was Sophia thinking when she sent me into the world? It's always been quite nice with the Seraphim. Okay, sometimes it's been kinda boring. But basically, it's been ... Well, as I said, quite nice. At least better than just standing around gaping.
You do have all the shackles, but there's no blood on them. My hunters told me what you did. One of them would like to talk to you. Why don't you go to him?

Kill the Minotaurs!

Greetings traveler! Do you have time to listen to an old man's problems? You see some bad things have been happening. Some of my servants wanted to go look at a nearby cave as a sort of dare, but none of them came back. A real live Minotaur has been spotted around here, I think the beasts live in the cave. You look like you know how to take care of yourself, so it probably wouldn't be a big deal for you to pay a visit to the cave and clean it out. You will be well-paid!

Guardian of Souls
If the world should blow itself up, the last audible voice would be that of an expert saying it can't be done.
- Sir Peter Ustinov
So this is the realm of the Dream Vampire. It looks a little strange.
Not bad ... not bad at all.
I will rebuild the business house. What do you think of a Fair Trade Center?
Unfortunately, I haven't been feeling at all well recently.
Well then, I hope you get better soon.
The Priests have given me some elixirs to put me back on my feet again.
I thank the Gods, my friend. What caused your unfortunate illness?
My Orc casserole on golden spinach wasn't quite the freshest...
Yes, not all of the Orc meat on the market is as fresh as one would hope. Orcs go bad quite quickly.
It taught me a lesson, that is certain.
Well then - may your day be untroubled, and I pray that you recover soon my friend.

Only the dead have seen the end of war.

Praying to Kuan also honors the dead. I should worship this God.

Winning a battle is no proof of heroism, enduring defeat is.

There's much wisdom to your words. I will worship Kuan.

Just as earthquakes cannot be stopped, wars cannot be won.

That's very deep. Thank you. I'll visit the Temple more often from now on.

He who wants to guard the peace has to be prepared for war.

I've never thought about that. Thank you.

The biggest lies are told before an election, during war, and after the hunt.

Your words have moved me. I will worship Kuan.
Did you wait 'til the Troll teeth fell out? The leader of the Ore-Thag Clan will not fall over that easily, I assure you. Kill him!
Oh? We go back, but not love? No, stay outcast with love!

Keeper of the Temple
It is in vain to expect our prayers to be heard, if we do not strive as well as pray.
- Aesop
I agree - any attempt at resistance is futile...
I'll tell you one thing: Be careful! We are watching you!
Ha ha! Who are you trying to scare? The pigs and the chickens?

The Orcs call their brutal sport "Nargutz." Apparently the aim of the game is to carry a Troll skull into the opposing team's end zone. How you accomplish that is up to you. The local derby match between Entruag and Tharak is scheduled to begin soon, but some Trolls have set up camp in the kick-off zone. If they're not removed the match will have to be canceled. Beni Keisar the Orc has asked me to kill the Trolls and bring back one of their heads - just in case the Orcs need an extra ball for the game.
I think it would be better if I didn't ask you for alms...
You see - I was once just like you!
Humph! Keep going! At least begging is an honest trade!
The armorer was very satisfied with the metal and has paid me well.
I’m sure Hassl’toh got home safely.
I don't want to think about what will happen if you don't find the amulet.
I was unable to protect Rinarn. He is dead. I should inform Lieutenant Niran.
A town! I can't stand towns, but after all the country air, it's still a nice change.
These six furs are almost an entire month's earnings for me. If only I had them already...
Attention. Armed objects within range of sensors.
Are you hungry? We have some fish left over from last Monday...
One word of advice: Chop off the head first, and ask questions later.
Many thanks for your help! I think Perhaps I should stay in town for a while. A thousand thanks, my friend!
The air's going to get thin down there pretty soon!
In the end, they get everybody ...
Who'll take care of my son ...?
I know where you've parked your car, player!
What? I need enemies, not victims!
Hurry we have to tell the Baron.
I beat things like that by the dozen...
Back into the grave with you!

You made it! Good! Spiders deserve to die! Every last one of them!
Here. Take this rat. It’s a nice fat one.
I found the dealer's toy, it looks like a little boy. I will return it to its “father.”
Get ready to face the God of jellyfish!
Look, guys! An ostrich in armor!
We'll take care of the chick with wings!
Do you have really bad lighting in your bathroom, or did you do that to your face on purpose?

The kennels are actually pantries, where the Humans and Lizardmen? are penned up as living meat supply for the Dragon. I set them free and talked to one of the Humans. He said there’s a group of rebels trying to save the people in the breeding pens, to keep them from becoming Dragon chow. Their leader is a man called “Blackhammer”. I should go talk to him.
Repent, before I fell you like a tree!

Gravestone
If you ask me anything I don't know, I'm not going to answer.
I have collected enough heads. Chuck Latbar will give me my reward.
I have to slay some jumping-plants. That’s not very hard for the first part of the job, but what’s it good for?
And just where do you buy your shoes?
Sometimes there are subversive elements around here.
It is not pleasant to spend every day in a smoky, stuffy atmosphere.
Today we are serving a pork roast with corn cakes.
I'm on top of my game today.
I now serve Fairy Gold wine for our female guests.
He's dead and both he and the sword were absorbed by hell. The Seraphim is dead as well. I think that takes care of the undead problem.
By Forens! I should deliver more sermons about the meaning of life.
Good. That wasn't too difficult now, was it?
I glad that you found my arguments so convincing.
I knew that my arguments would convince you.
It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
It was a pleasure doing business with you guys.

You want to help me once more? Great!

The wolves must have found shelter nearby, or they wouldn't attack this often. Please chase them away, while I tend to my wounds. I didn't quite make it through the last fight unharmed.
The list shows that those who fell were from my unit, but I still need the soldiers' dog tags.
How is one supposed to work in this filth?
Mashed potatoes with poached eggs. That tastes good and provides energy.
Only the grits hear my groaning.
In my profession it isn't easy, thanks be to the Gods, to starve to death.
Shepherd's pie is being served today.

What drama! Lappsess, the innkeeper, has run out of lukewarm lumpy swill. He’s expecting more guests and he wants to serve slimy gobs and goo with traditional lumpy swill. He’s asked me to order a new barrel of swill from Fangor, the swill brewer. Now there's an Orc I can help!

Michel was reasonable in the end. I hope he stays that way.
The sword he gave me handles very well, and he said the blacksmith would be able to improve it even more. We'll see, maybe I'll be able to talk his master into doing just that by giving him a few gold pieces. At least he seems to feel inclined to take on orders again.

I hope Michel lives long enough to become a great blacksmith. He really seems to have what it takes.
Mark my words, this is but one battle won in a lost war!

That was a pleasantly simple task and the reward was reasonable too.
The olms got Hassl'toh! What a pity, but he knew it was dangerous.

Your money or your life! Pay the toll.

This bridge belongs to us! Anyone who wants to cross it must pay the bridge toll! Those who don't pay get their throats slit!
The smallest house has space. But not my backpack.
Ah, what a delightful day - ´tis a day for promenading!
An idle life is full of pleasures.
For days now I have pondered just one question - what should I do with all my money?
Being rich is nothing to be ashamed of - it's the only way to live!
Ah, an opulent meal is what I need now!
My Lord, we live in such wicked times! These people dare to speak in public of freedom!
Truly, I am blessed with good fortune and gold.
People are slothful beings per se.

A shabby guy and a pathetic spy want to arrest me. Don't make me laugh! Guards!
Saving content... Please do not turn off your console.
How many more of you are there?
It's a bit early for that.
I'll be back... with an army!
Out of my way! I have to leave now!
While you're here, why don't you talk to the landlord of the tavern on the outskirts of town. Just to make sure these scoundrels haven't robbed him too.
Lizard creature, I stand for law and order.
